caption: United States v. Auernheimer
citation_line: United States v. Auernheimer, No. 2:11-cr-00470; conviction vacated, 748 F.3d 525 (3d Cir. 2014)
headnote_district_ruling: Judge Wigenton rejected a venue challenge and entered judgment after a jury convicted Andrew Auernheimer of Computer Fraud and Abuse Act conspiracy and identity fraud arising from the collection of AT&T iPad subscriber data.
qualification_rationale: The prosecution attracted sustained attention in computer-law circles and produced a major appellate venue ruling for crimes committed over interconnected networks.
appellate_posture_note: The Third Circuit reversed the venue determination and vacated the conviction in a precedential opinion because no essential conduct element occurred in New Jersey.
